name: jbeat-conventions
description: Cross-language engineering conventions for scoped changes, project-rule conflict choices, clear writing, and honest verification.

interface.shortDescription: Scoped changes, project-rule choices, and honest verification
interface.longDescription: Prompt-based engineering conventions across languages. Run jbeat-setup once per project to connect the installed apply skill through existing CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md instructions, then make normal work requests. The apply skill routes relevant references, asks users to resolve actual local-rule conflicts, and reviews changed artifacts before completion. No bundled runtime scripts, hooks, or Node.js dependency. MCP tools are optional.
defaultPrompt: Review this patch with Jbeat conventions.
Refactor this code without changing behavior.
Apply Jbeat naming and comment rules.
